text.name: Short text
text.description: One line: a name, code or title

select.name: Dropdown
select.description: Pick one option from a list

paragraph.name: Paragraph
paragraph.defaultText: Add instructions for the people filling in this form.

editor.typeLocked: The type is locked: stored answers depend on it.
editor.label: Label
editor.keyHint: Where the answer is stored. Starts with a lowercase letter; letters, digits and _ only.
editor.keyLocked: Locked: answers are already stored under this key.
editor.requiredHint: People must answer before they can submit.
editor.requiredHintBoolean: People must tick the box before they can submit (e.g. accepting terms).
editor.optionValueLocked: Locked: answers already use this value.
editor.patternHint: A regular expression the whole answer must match.
editor.visibleWhenHint: Hidden fields are skipped and never stored.
editor.noOtherFields: Add another field first; conditions compare this one with the answers to other fields.
editor.dividerHint: A divider has nothing to edit, but it can be shown conditionally.

issues.keyInvalid: The key must start with a lowercase letter and use only letters, digits and _
issues.keyDuplicate: Another field already uses the key “{key}”
issues.optionValueRequired: Every option needs a stored value
issues.optionValuesDuplicate: Two options have the same stored value
issues.rangeInvalid: The maximum is below the minimum
issues.lengthInvalid: The maximum length is below the minimum
issues.patternInvalid: This pattern is invalid or could be very slow
issues.defaultInvalid: The default value doesn't pass this field's own rules
issues.conditionSelf: A field can't depend on itself
issues.conditionUnknown: The condition refers to a field that no longer exists

dnd.instructions: To pick up an item, press Space or Enter. Use the arrow keys to move it, Space or Enter to drop it, or Escape to cancel.
dnd.outside: {item} is not over a drop position.

custom.title: Custom fields
custom.description: Extra fields for people, groups and departments. Values are stored with each record, shown on its page and usable in filters.
custom.noAccess: You don't have access to manage custom fields.
custom.listDescription: Drag to change the order they appear in on the record's form.
custom.emptyDescription: Add a field to capture information your organisation needs, like a cost center or office.
custom.usage: {count, plural, =0 {Not used yet} one {Used by # record} other {Used by # records}}
custom.archiveBody: {count, plural, =0 {The field disappears from forms and filters. You can restore it later.} one {The field disappears from forms and filters. The value stored on # record is kept and comes back if you restore it.} other {The field disappears from forms and filters. The values stored on # records are kept and come back if you restore it.}}
custom.addDescription: The field appears in the “Additional information” section of the form and the record's page.
custom.editDescription: The key and type can't change once the field exists; everything else can.
custom.usageNote: {count, plural, one {# record already has a value: its key, type and option values are locked.} other {# records already have a value: its key, type and option values are locked.}}
custom.previewDescription: The section as it appears on the {entity} form. Try the answers to see conditional fields appear.
custom.previewEmpty: Add a field to see the preview.

entity.cardDescription: Custom fields defined by your administrators.
